title: World View V1 Built-in Relationship Type Descriptor Registry

common_rules.identity: Core Domain-generated stable relationship_id; never reused.
common_rules.endpoints: Exactly one source and one target Object; same Project and valid target Map context.
common_rules.symmetric: Canonicalize endpoint order deterministically; never persist inverse duplicate.
common_rules.storage: Typed payload in Shared Object definition, Map Initial State or Command; no standalone relationship table in V1.
common_rules.temporal: Initial State at time zero; History-local via establish/end Commands; no independent UTC interval.
common_rules.geometry: Coincidence, intersection, adjacency and snapping never auto-create a formal relationship.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active edge per type and ordered endpoint pair

spatial.contains.geometry_precondition: Validation evidence only; geometry does not create the relationship.
spatial.contains.status: Candidate matrix; semantic containment and cardinality require ME-02/ME-03 review.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active parent for enabled MountainPeak to MountainRange pair

structural.part_of.status: MountainPeak pair candidate; Settlement hierarchy deferred.

cardinality.uniqueness: canonical unordered endpoint pair per type

spatial.adjacent_to.geometry_precondition: Explicit adjacency meaning required; distance threshold alone is insufficient.
spatial.adjacent_to.status: Candidate; exact predicate remains type-specific validation.

cardinality.uniqueness: canonical unordered endpoint pair per type

network.connects_to.geometry_precondition: Explicit network/access connectivity; geometric touch or snapping is insufficient.
network.connects_to.status: Candidate; Road-Settlement access semantics require ME-02 review.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active edge per type and ordered endpoint pair

hydrology.flows_to.cycle_policy: reject_directed_cycle; multiple tributaries and distributary edges may be allowed after hydrology validation
hydrology.flows_to.geometry_precondition: Flow direction is explicit; centerline vertex order is not authoritative.
hydrology.flows_to.status: Candidate; confluence, distributary and outlet rules require ME-02 review.

compatibility_policy.schema_change: Increment schema_version and provide explicit compatibility/migration behavior.
compatibility_policy.semantics_change: Change semantics_id; retain original reader/semantics for historical relationships.
compatibility_policy.endpoint_matrix_change: Breaking semantic change; do not silently reinterpret existing relationships.

validation_note: This file is a machine-readable domain catalog, not a JSON Schema validation document. Runtime validation rules are expressed as descriptor data and must be implemented by Core Domain validators.
